title: 有馬記念の後に・憧れの先へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is so incredible, none of us remember to even breathe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The moment Fuji Kiseki flies past the finish line with all her strength, the stands ring with cries of jubilation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was incredible! What a fantastic race!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! She's so beautiful! Fuji, that was stunning!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for the wonderful show! Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Her audience of thousands hung onto her every word.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Her every breath and movement was like that of a dream to them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Now burn the image of my form upon those beautiful eyes of yours, dark and deep as the night!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's that same sight…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Calm down. I must remain an entertainer until the very end!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki closes her eyes softly and bows her head reverentially to the stands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm incredibly humbled to have the honor of receiving such a love-filled standing ovation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The drama of my senior year ends here, and it's time for the actors to return to the wings of the stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But please, worry not! My tale is not yet over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She spreads her hands wide, and a single firework shoots into the sky and blooms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My efforts today will continue into the future, and I promise to bring more miracles to you all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Goodbye for now! Be well, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She exits her stage, leaving behind the twinkling sky, and everyone sees her off with eyes full of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And thus concludes chapter one.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I didn't win, but the audience remained untouched by the grays of disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everyone had such a good time watching me progress through the challenge I set for myself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just knowing that makes me happier than anything.
choice_data_list: You gave them the greatest show ever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, I did. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ruby sunset illuminates the profile of her face as she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is my path… No, that's not it. This is where I belong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She turns away from me abruptly before I have a chance to say anything.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, we can't spend forever wallowing in sentimentality!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The end is only the beginning. There are still plenty of places I need to go. So come on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Together, we can go anywhere.
